Fall Quarter, 2026 Registration for term ends on Tuesday, September 15, 2026

Claire Trevor School of the Arts

Claire Trevor School of the Arts comments:

DROP: The deadline to drop courses at the Claire Trevor School of the Arts is the end of Week 2 by 5:00PM. Drops can be made in WebReg.

CHANGE: The deadline to change grade option or variable units is at the end of Week 2 by 5:00PM. Changes can be made in WebReg.

ADD: The deadline to add courses in the Claire Trevor School of the Arts is the end of Week 2 by 5:00PM. Adds can be made in WebReg.

Major restrictions for some courses will be removed on Monday, August 24th, 2026 at noon.

New Only Restrictions (NORs) will be removed on Friday, August 21st at noon.

How to enroll for next quarter: http://www.arts.uci.edu/student-affairs-next-quarter-enroll.

For additional questions, email artscounselor@uci.edu.

Art

Art department comments:

Students are welcome to enroll in courses when the major restrictions are removed; see above for the date/time when major restrictions will be removed.

Instructors will give "add" and "drop" codes through the second week of classes, based on availability.
